channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Derek Harper | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Derek Harper from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Derek Harper
item.description:
John Starks, Anthony Bonner, Greg Anthony and Harper took turns attempting to slow down Jordan’s silky drives and dead-on jumpers.

“I remember we were trying to give him a different look,’’ said Harper, who played for the Knicks from 1994-96 and now is TV analyst for the Dallas Mavericks. “But we couldn’t stop him that night. He was on fire. He was on a different planet. There was no answer for him. I’m a decent defender, but I guarded him too late. He was already hot.”

Michael Jordan on Derek Harper, May 10, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Rolando Blackman on Derek Harper
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rolando Blackman on Derek Harper:

“You have to know the personalities he had to deal with, including our coach, including Mark (Aguirre), including me.”

Rolando Blackman on Derek Harper, Jan 7, 2018. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Derek Harper
item.description:
Cuban said when asked if Terry’s jersey would go up soon.

“I’d say there’s a good chance [Harper’s number will be retired]. But I’m in no rush to do that.”

Mark Cuban on Derek Harper, Dec 13, 2012. Source: Dallas Morning News.
